derived_from.rule: the midpoint-of-overlap re-cut of section 1.1 of the 2026-09-06 boundary-exact preregistration, applied as a strictly subtractive SLICE of the sealed dev-v1 clip

split_role_basis: The SAME 1,500 published segments the sealed 2026-09-05 arm A already read, re-encoded by one deterministic rule from the sealed dev-v1 bytes. No owner allowance is involved and none is claimed: dev is the split this study may optimize on. No confirmatory call is named, loaded, decoded or scored, and the six calibration-exposed ESB test calls stay a separate population with a separate roster, reference layer and derived media root.
